title: Unique normalized successor homology comparison
statement: Let $C$ be abelian [def-sp-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, $F$ a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration], $r\ge1$, and $D$ representative differential data [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]. At every bidegree $a=(p,q)$ there is exactly one isomorphism $e:H(D.\mathrm{page})^a\cong Q_{r+1}^a$, where $Q_s^a=\operatorname{coker}(B_s^{p,p+q}\to Z_s^{p,p+q})$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], with the following property: for every containment proof $h_Z:Z_{r+1}^{p,p+q}\le Z_r^{p,p+q}$ and every map $f:Z_{r+1}^{p,p+q}\to\operatorname{cycles}(D.\mathrm{page})^a$ satisfying $f\iota_{\mathrm{cycles}}=\operatorname{ofLE}(h_Z)\pi_r$, one has $f\pi_H e=\pi_{r+1}$.

source.place: Tag 012K, Lemmas 12.24.2 and 12.24.4; parent proof step 1, normalized quotient-of-quotients comparison; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: Monotonicity of the filtration and of pullback, image, intersection and sum gives the containment of successor cycles in current cycles.

The successor-cycle cover f is epic. Reuse the private pullback_kernel theorem from FilteredComplexPageHomology via a proof-only import all. The successor-boundary image formula then computes the kernel of f followed by the homology projection. The resulting exact short complex makes that composite a cokernel of the successor boundary inclusion.

Compare this cokernel with the concrete successor page cokernel using their universal properties. The comparison satisfies the normalization. Monicity of the page cycle inclusion makes all f in the normalization equal; epimorphic cancellation proves uniqueness of the comparison.

theorem filteredComplex_normalized_homology
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    ∃! e : D.page.homology pq ≅ filteredComplexPageObject K F (r + 1) pq,
      FilteredComplexHomologyNormalized K F r D pq e
